content:
According to tradition, in the coming days, users who post on X platform with the #AppleEvent hashtag will see a custom-made Apple logo hashmoji in their posts. See below for details.

#AppleEvent hashmoji has debuted on the X platform

For years, every time Apple schedules a new event, the company rolls out a custom X hashmoji to match the occasion.

Shortly after sending out the event invitation earlier today — which featured an apple-shaped halo orbiting the sun, along with the tagline "Surprise and shine" — the company's new hashmoji has now appeared on X.

That means when users post with #AppleEvent on the platform, they will see a custom Apple logo next to the hashtag, designed based on the invitation graphic.

Apple's "Surprise and shine" event is scheduled for September 9 at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time, and the company is expected to announce the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, as well as its first foldable iPhone. Rumors also point to new Apple Watch and AirPods models.

Apple's hashmoji appeared on X just a few hours after the company's Senior Vice President of Marketing Greg Jozwiak posted on the platform to preview it. Tim Cook subsequently reposted Jozwiak's message and added his own comment.

Interestingly, some people have interpreted Cook's mention of "countdown" as an Easter egg, hinting at his own countdown: he is set to step down as Apple CEO on September 1, transitioning to the role of Executive Chairman.

9to5Mac will be on the ground at Apple Park on September 9, so stay tuned for our coverage before, during, and after the event.

Are you excited about this event? Let us know in the comments.
